subject: planner: fix the can't find column error for nested join with agg converted from apply (#66241)
summary: Introduces a post-decorrelation traversal that calls `MergeSchema()` on all `LogicalJoin`/`LogicalApply` nodes to restore pruned join/apply output schemas (preventing “can’t find column” during later agg/group-by handling), adds a regression integration test for a correlated scalar subquery with nested joins, and updates one analyze-suite golden warning line. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in planner correctness/semantics.
